messages.text: Lab ran long and the wind on 19th is gross. Can I call from the SUB after I print the readings?
Yes. I am home after 6. Did the card cover the printing and the field notebook?
It did. Also read the second link before we talk, not just the headline. I am going to ask what changed your mind.
Fair. I will read it before dinner and not bluff my way through.
You were up before 4 again. Please don't start the day by refreshing the work thread.
I know. Too many loose pieces on that service rollout and I wanted to see what moved overnight.
Then put the loose pieces on paper before breakfast. Also you snapped at the toaster like it owed you money.
Fair. I'll make the short list, walk the north loop at lunch, and leave the thread alone tonight.
I put the leftover chicken, carrots, and spinach in the front of the fridge. Easier than drifting to the deli counter again.
Saw it. Packing that with an apple.
Good. Forecast says clear at noon, so take the river path before the wind picks up.
I'll block 12:20 and keep it to one beer if Dave still wants Katabatic after work.
Owen has robotics until 6:15. I can grab him if you stop staring at the work queue and start the rice.
Rice is on. Work queue is still ugly.
Write the three things that actually have to happen tonight on the pad. Everything else can wait until morning.
Pad says dishes, Owen pickup backup, insurance email. That helped.
Can I borrow the small flush cutters after dinner? Robotics wire ends look terrible.
Yes. They are on the basement bench by the soldering mat. Try not to move the labelled feeder bundles.
The tiny depot lights are still on. Is that supposed to be testing?
For ten minutes, yes. I want the west curve to behave before I put the couch back flat for Claire.
Mom said Tom is ignoring that county notice again. Same man who argues with the TV about weather alerts.
You still doing that Glacier weekend this month or did the tire shop win?
Saw an old Broncos clip and remembered that Denver office you had. Still weird you walked away from that setup.
Send me the link. I usually compare those with Dr. Patel's portal note before I tell him anything.
Tire shop, dentist, and Claire's lab fees all took a swing. I moved the campsite hold off the March calendar for now.
It was a good setup on paper. Harder to argue with seeing the kids grow up with the river ten minutes away.
March is rude. Broncos would find a way to fumble a receipt.
Fair. You always sounded less wound up after those early Montana weekends.
We're doing pantry chili Friday instead of Neptune's. Same glamour, fewer tabs.
Those mornings below the Absarokas did more for my head than another promotion conversation.
Will do. Also, did you ever move that chair appointment Megan mentioned, or is it still haunting the fridge?
Moved it again. I took the 7:20 treadmill slot tomorrow instead and packed leftover soup, no deli slices.
did you read that piece I sent about the stop data in Bozeman? half the categories were just blank. how is anyone supposed to know if things are getting better
got through it on lunch. you're right that the gaps are the story. if they tracked use of force and outcomes the same way across counties we'd actually have something to compare
ok but reading is not the same as showing up. there's a march on the 21st
I hear you. not my way of doing it, kid. I'm putting the time into the school board and the county race instead. let's argue about it Sunday over dinner
Saw your shot of the Yellowstone bend from Saturday. That light was nuts.
Yeah I posted it before I even got home. Caption was just the river name and the date.
Classic you. No story, no hashtags, just the picture and out.
Works for me. If I had a clean shot of that brown I'd have put that up instead but it was too dark by then.
Les Schwab called. All four tires plus the alignment came to $812. I told them go ahead.
Your aunt tagged you in another batch of cousin photos. Looks like the whole Dubuque crew was at the lake.
Ouch. Pull it from the regular checking, we've got it. Not fun but not a crisis.
Yeah. Just glad we didn't have to touch the Bozeman fund. Claire's spring bill is sitting in the inbox too.
Saw them at lunch. Scrolled past the comment fight under the lake post though, not worth it.
I'll move some over Friday after payroll hits. Let's hold off on the deck stain until June.
Ha. Also the trailhead cleanup the outdoor club posted is the 21st, want me to put it on the fridge calendar?
Yeah add it. And the library volunteer group is doing the book sort that same weekend, I signed up Saturday morning.
light still on in there. you good?
yeah. fifty pages from the end of the Shaara. one more chapter then I'm out
you said that two chapters ago
fair. Gettysburg's about to start, I can't stop now
Robotics ran late. Are we still doing pasta or should I grab something?
Pasta. I started sauce and put on the old Wilco album. Grab basil if you pass Albertsons.
Ok. Do you need anything else?
Just basil. I opened one BridgePort with the sauce, so you are driving if we run back out later.
Are the black poles in the mudroom yours? I need the bench for soldering.
Mine. Leave them there tonight; I have to adjust the locks before Saturday.
One tip cover is missing.
That is the one I replaced with the carbide tip. More grip on loose downhill stuff.
Dad says the furnace guy is coming Friday. He made it sound like I personally ordered the cold front.
That tracks. Tell him I said to let you handle the quote before he starts taking panels off himself.
Will do. Also, your orange helmets managed to make a third-and-14 look generous last night.
I saw enough before bed. Save the full complaint list for the next call.
Talked to Mom for a bit. She said Dad's hands were giving him trouble fixing the dryer belt last night. Same stubborn routine, wouldn't let her call the repair guy.
Of course he didn't. Forty plus years rebuilding conveyor motors and now he can't watch someone else turn a screwdriver in his own basement.
Yeah. She also said the statement from Dubuque Telco Credit Union came in wrong again, took her an hour on the phone. She's still faster at that stuff than the kid behind the counter.
Twenty-six years processing loan files will do that. I'll call them Sunday.
saw the county sent out the new property tax notice. mine went up again. yours?
yeah opened it last night. up about 9 percent. mostly the school levy and the bond for the road work past the bridge
school part i dont mind as much. road money i want to see actually move dirt this year
agreed. id rather pay it and see the work done than argue about it. going to look at the assessor breakdown this weekend
Mom wants to know if you're coming back for the big one in May. She's already talking about a cake.
Ran into Mr. Halvorsen at the pharmacy today. He asked about you. Said he still tells kids about the one who actually finished what he started after that TI-83 unit.
Tell her not to go nuts. It's just the 14th, same as every year.
No way he's still around. He has to be pushing 80.
Yeah but this one's a round number for you. Fifty's a thing whether you like it or not.
Looks it. Said the rest of you treated his classroom like a dare and you were the one who took it home and didn't put it down. I told him you parlayed it into the whole career.
Megan's already threatening a steak dinner. I'll see if I can swing a long weekend in Dubuque later in the summer instead.
Tell him hi if you see him again. That guy plus the labs at NICC basically wrote the next 25 years of my life.
Before you start anything loud, can you grab potatoes and two carrots from the bins? I can do onions when I get in.
Yep. I need to patch that back-step board first, then I’ll get soup going.
The lender portal shows the March draft cleared. Please don’t add fancy hardware to the step project.
Scrap board and screws already in the garage. Rosemary and thyme too?
Do you want the Costco receipt or just the total? I also found the dentist card slip in my coat.
Both, if you have them. February is sitting at 7,184 before I check the tire shop line.
Of course that is the month the back molar and four tires decided to team up.
I will put those two off to the side so the regular columns do not look completely deranged.
If I come home after lab, are you doing Pine Creek or staying around town?
Watching the snow line. Pine Creek if it firms up, otherwise I need to turn over the beds by the fence.
Bring the poles if we go up there. Last time that shaded corner was all ice.
Deal. I will keep it short enough that I can still get the tomato frames fixed before dinner.
Gauge is still high at Carter's. Wind looks tolerable before 10.
I'll load the waders and the 5-weight. Same turnout by 7?
Yep. Linda said the LORC note had Pine Creek muddy, so let's stay lower.
Works. Coffee is on me if Mark's access tip saves us a wasted drive.
I stopped by after Hy-Vee. Tom was using the cane in the kitchen again and said the back step felt slick.
Thanks. I put the rail estimate on my list for tomorrow night with them.
Good. Eileen says he'll grumble less if it sounds like your idea from Montana and not me bossing him around.
I'll tread carefully. Send me the contractor's number before dinner if you have it.
Did you ever print the W route notes, or are they still living in twelve browser tabs?
Printed the camp page and marked two versions. Still just pencil lines and maybes.
Good. Pencil is cheaper than the kind of bold move that shows up on the statement.
I know. I put this month's bit aside after groceries cleared.
Talked to Ma yesterday. She's already on about the corned beef for Tuesday, wants to know if you're calling in around dinner like usual.
Yeah I'll ring around 6 your time. She still doing it the way Grandma Maeve did or did Dad finally win the cabbage argument
Same as always. She also asked if Megan wants the soda bread recipe written down before she forgets it. I think she means it this time.
Tell her yes. Megan's been bugging me for it since the kids were small. Dubuque kitchen secrets don't transfer well over the phone.
If we do Drinking Horse Saturday, can you send Mom the trail and back-by time before we leave?
Already in the notes app. Car at the Bridger lot, out by 10:30, back by 1:00 unless weather turns.
Good. Also I am not lending you my field hat again if you forget yours.
Fair. Mine is clipped to the pack with the little orange pouch and two SPF sticks.
Dad your aunt is again sharing that miracle turmeric cure thing in the cousins group. Three relatives are in the comments agreeing.
I saw. No citation, big claim, lots of caps. Not engaging with that thread.
Lol you sound like you when you make me check whoever wrote a thing.
There was a YPR segment last week on the same supplement, way more careful. I'll send you the link from the station's site instead.
Why does your whole feed look like a Glacier brochure and a lumberyard had a baby
saw the stop data thing you sent. ok but what's your actual take on it dad
Because that's what I look at. Two park photographers, the cedar joinery guy you sent me, and Dave's fishing buddy from Bozeman.
haven't landed yet. want to see who the policy actually applies to, what the supervisor incentives look like, and the denominator they used before I say something I can't back up
Lol no rage posts no doomscroll therapy threads just trees and tenons
lol classic. so a week from now you'll have a tab open with three pdfs
If I'm having a rough day I am not going to that app to feel better. I'll go talk to your mom. You know that.
four. give me till weekend. I'd rather give you a real answer than a fast one
card statement landed. $2,847 this cycle with the tires and Owen's dental
yeah saw it. transfer is queued to clear the full balance wednesday like always
ok. rainy day took it on the chin though
we are back down to like four months. ugh
got a ride home with Jacob, don't need pickup
Good. I have a 4:30 pairing with Priya on the auth service and I'd have been late getting to the school
k. dinner at 7?
7 works. Mom said leftovers. After that can you walk me through your robotics PID code, I want to see what you have
hey the autonomous routine keeps timing out on the encoder test. python script Mr. Halberg wrote
send me the traceback. is it the loop in the while-true or the SQL log write at the end?
while loop i think. it just hangs
ok push it to the team git repo and I'll pull it after dishes. need to write a unit test around the encoder call so we can see what it's actually returning
talked to dad sunday, he's already planning his march 17 corned beef like clockwork. mom said she's adding grandma's kraut on the side this year
every year he's the same. how's his hip
creaky but he's stubborn. heading over after work tomorrow. you talked to him?
sunday call. asked when we're driving back through dubuque next. told him probably june once owen's done with school
Mom called. Dad's PT copay jumped to $45 a session and he's at 8 a month now. You good to bump what we're sending?
Yeah. Take-home here is about $5,600 after everything, we can do another 150 a month no problem.
I'll match. Tom won't ask so we just do it.
Megan's outfitter check covers Owen's robotics stuff so the cushion is there. Send Mom the new total when you talk.
dad did you see the thread my roommate tagged you in? the one about the wilderness study area
saw the notification, didnt open it. i dont jump into those comment sections. if you want to talk it through saturday i will
thats fair. short version: forest service is taking public comment until the 27th on the access road and i want to know what you think
ok send me the actual comment portal link, not the screenshot fight. ill read the proposal first, then we can sit down with coffee saturday
I put turkey back and grabbed hummus, peppers, and those low-salt crackers. You can pretend this was your idea.
Fair. I walked two laps by the river before eating, so I am accepting partial credit.
Partial credit withheld until you call about the little reminder postcard under the toaster.
I saw it. I'll call after I read the Mayo page Claire sent about Dad's spring shots.
Reminder, you wanted to look at the county commissioner forum stream tonight. 7pm on the Enterprise site.
Yeah. The water rights one and the road levy questions are what I want to hear.
Okay. I'll put the chicken in around 6 so we eat before it starts.
Perfect. Owen has robotics til 6:30, can grab him on the way back from the library.
Office door been shut since 4. You said you'd stop by 5:30.
Sorry. Logged 9.5 today, just closing out the ticket queue.
Again? That's the third night this week past 7. Owen ate without you.
I know. Friday's lighter, only the 1pm standup. I'll be done by 3.
servo on the arm is jittering when we send the close cmd. think it's the PWM signal but idk
come grab me after dishes. bring the laptop and the multimeter.
k. also can you drop me at school 6:15 thursday, bus leaves for the Bozeman course at 6:45
yep. I'll be there for the 10am start, leaving work at 9.
MSU posted the housing charge. It is due the 20th. Sorry, I know March already looks annoying.
Send me the exact amount when you can. I am moving a few lines around after groceries and utilities landed.
1,150. I can cover books this time if that helps.
Thanks. Keep your books covered and I will fit this into the March sheet tonight.
Field lab got moved, so I can come home Friday. Can we do that overlook by the Absarokas before dinner?
Yes. That view always makes my spreadsheet problems look about the right size.
Good. Also I want your version of why you and Mom picked Livingston when Denver would have been easier.
Fair question. Short version: easier was not the same as better for Saturdays, kids, and breathing room.
Are you and Mom still coming through Bozeman on your way north? I can send my field boots home with you.
Not that weekend. I switched the northbound stuff after the car and tooth bills landed.
If we do Pine Creek Sunday, can we keep it to the lower trail? My lab group might join.
Lower trail works. I am skipping the steep connector this time.
Got it. I can bring the boots when I come for laundry.
Bring the poles then. Last mile down there is all loose rock.
Already in the truck. I also need the short band-walk set before breakfast.
Thanks. We're also skipping Ale Works after your lab-fee email, so dinner here is whatever survives the freezer.
My advisor was bugging me about whether I'd ever do a second degree after the BS. I told her you got into this whole field with a two-year out of Calmar and she looked at me like I made it up.
Ha. Tell her the first three years I was just resetting passwords and rebuilding printers. Programming came later.
She asked if you'd ever go back for a bachelor's or a master's. I said you haven't cracked a syllabus in like 20+ years and you weren't planning to.
Accurate. Last time I sat in a classroom Bush was president. Different one.
owen left his FAFSA pages on the counter again. parent income section done?
almost. W2 PDF still importing. that benefit eligibility section we just mark N/A right? none of those categories apply to us

yes N/A all of them. also marketplace renewal hits saturday - silver plan still the cheapest for us since we don't have employer or any of those federal-coverage options to fall back on. you doing the comparison or me?
i'll do it. oh - aunt sue resent grandma schmidt's bread recipe. third time this month. tell her i got it the first time lol
Tara from the outfitter asked again if you'd be open to a coffee. Some recruiter pinged her on that site looking for senior backend people
tell her thanks but I'm not really browsing. I barely log in over there
she said your headshot is still the one from before Owen's braces came off lol
fair. I'll swap the photo and the title line this weekend. that's about all I'm doing on it
I moved $325 from checking so the Bozeman auto-pay will not bounce tomorrow.
Thanks. I will cover groceries this weekend if she comes over the pass.
She said she is bringing a duffel and the packet you promised to read. Please actually mark it up.
I put it in my bag. She will know in ten seconds if I skimmed.
Can you stop sanding that chair rung before dinner smells like sawdust?
One more pass. The joint finally sits square, and the soup needs another twenty anyway.
Also leave a walking path downstairs. Your cork roadbed strips are creeping toward the pullout again.
I will stack them under the bench after I test the glue line.
Marlene called the house — she said the trustees want a one-pager before the April meeting. Six weeks, intro to spreadsheets, something like that.
Yeah I figured. I want to pitch it as four tracks — browser basics, email, spreadsheets, and a job-search one. Run them in sequence so the same folks can stick with it.
Don't try to do all four yourself. You already give them a Saturday a month.
I know. I'll ask if anyone from the Outdoor Rec board would co-teach one. Half those guys are retired engineers.
you've been at the kitchen table with that practice exam every night this week. how's it going
78% on the timed one tonight. Need 80 consistently before I book the test. Sketching out the diagram review template for the team too, before Priya and Marcus do their PR walkthrough tomorrow
you're doing too many things at 9pm again. Claire called by the way, she said she's fine staying in Bozeman this weekend, going hiking with that group from her lab
Good for her. I'll close the laptop after I send the agenda. Walk in the morning?
Can I stay after for drivetrain testing? Need pickup 5:40 not 4:20.
Checking with Megan. Dinner may slide.
Ok. Also she said you were supposed to make the red/blue list before opening the laptop again.
Can you pick me up after robotics at 5:10? Also the side gate won’t latch again.
Fair. Tell her the red list is two items now.
I’ll swing by. Leave the gate alone until I can look at the hinge.
Dinner before coding help or after?
Before. Megan asked me to use the kale and tomatoes tonight, so we’ll eat around 6:30.
Can we do the drivetrain code at 7:10 instead of right after dinner?
Yeah. Is it broken again
No, I just barked about the shoes by the back door and need twenty minutes in the shop first.
Ok. I'll push the latest changes and eat slower.
couple of us grabbing pints at Katabatic tonight if you want in
appreciate it, sitting this one out. fire's going, got that Larson book half done
ha. same as last time
river saturday though if the wind cooperates
Pat left a voicemail on the house line. Something about Eileen's sidewalk being slick again.
I'll call him after dinner. If it's the front steps, he can probably see it before I can do anything useful from here.
He also asked if you watched the fourth quarter. That sounded like a trap.
It is always a trap when he starts with the fourth quarter.
Are Dave, Linda, and Mark the only ones for chili Sunday, or did I miss someone from Thursday?
Just those three. Thursday was mostly signups and trail tools, not dinner people.
Good. I'll do one pot and the cornbread. Ask Dave if he's bringing that river map he left here.
Will do. Mark also has the LORC key box, so I'll remind him before Sunday.
Broncos thread is already loud tonight. You watching or pretending to be productive?
Soup is on, John Prine is on, and I have one Great Divide left in the fridge. Productive enough.
Dad would call that a full program.
Better than chasing the group chat all night. One bottle, dishes, then I am done with screens.
The glaciology lecture had a Torres del Paine slide and I thought of your folder.
That folder is getting embarrassingly thick for a thing with no dates attached.
Send me the map version with the side trip you circled. I want to see if it makes sense.
I'll send it after lunch. Still trimming days so it doesn't turn into a money fire.
USGS has the Yellowstone at 2,480 and clearing. Wind looks mean after 11.
I can do an early run. Waders are patched and I tied a few smaller olives last night.
Mallard's Rest at 7:30? Coffee first if it looks brown.
Works. If it blows out, I may use the morning on that ridge above Suce Creek instead.
Dave wants Pine Creek instead of the river. I left the route card on the fridge and sent you the pin.
I see it. Turnaround noon, home by 2 unless you text otherwise?
Yes. Whistle, lighter, blanket, extra layer all packed. I put your green cap in the truck too.
Thank you. Add the big SPF bottle, not the sad little one that lives under the seat.
Hey, random question for a class thing. When Grandpa Tom was at the plant, was he the guy who actually fixed the line when it went down, or did he just supervise?
He was the guy with the wrench. Hydraulic presses, conveyors, the big ammonia compressors. They'd page him at 2am if something seized.
Ok that's what I thought. And Grandma did the books somewhere right? I never remember if it was a bank or what.
Member-owned place, downtown Dubuque. Started on the teller window after she did those night classes, ended up processing the auto and home equity files.
DMV reminder came in the mail. License renewal by May 14. Don't forget like last time.
Ha. They time it perfectly, don't they.
Always have. Also Claire asked what you want. I said you'd say nothing and mean it.
She's not wrong. Maybe a new reel. Tell her don't make a big deal of the round number.
Dinner can wait until 7:45 if you still want the quiet stretch for Iowa.
Yes, thanks. I want to hear whether Tom actually let Patrick measure by the basement stairs.
I'll keep Owen from starting the blender right next to you. Ask Eileen how her appointment went too.
Good call. I'll start right after I clear the dishes.
Tom told me you got pulled over coming back from the airport last month. you never said anything
ha. tail light. guy was polite, ran the plate, sent me on my way. about the third time anything like that has happened in my whole life
lol meanwhile your record is still cleaner than the church bulletin
yeah well that's exactly why I keep telling Claire the system looks different depending where you're standing in it. I've gotten the easy version. doesn't mean everyone does
Mom said Dad's PT guy wants another six weeks. that gonna stretch you?
HSA covers our share of what we chip in, that is what it is sitting there for
not booking the fall trip till the rainy day is back up to six months though
yeah smart. how far off you sitting
Field methods lab needs a $140 gear deposit by Friday. I can put it on my card if it's a bad week.
Don't. Send me the Venmo. We've got you on this stuff.
K. The advisor mentioned a summer research stipend application — would help with fall housing if I get it.
Apply. Every dollar of that helps the long math, especially with Owen lining up next year.
you've been at that sheet for two nights. is this the parent thing or the work thing
both kinda. the bug at work — root cause was a config drift two sprints back, not the last commit. nobody's fault on its own, the review process let it through
and Iowa?
narrowed it to three aide agencies + the rail. want to send Patrick the side-by-side before Sunday's call so we're not deciding on vibes
happy paddy's dad!! tell mom save me corned beef for sunday pls
she's already plating yours. tradition's locked in. you wearing green up there?

obvi. also my history seminar did a family migration mapping thing today - I told her grandpa tom's side came to dubuque in the 1880s and worked the railyards, mom's grandparents had the farm by bellevue. easier than my roommate who had like four time zones to chase down for hers
yeah easy on our side. dubuque and bellevue is the whole map. nobody ventured back the other way after they got off the boat
Did your absentee for the May ballot ever show up? Mine still hasn't and I'm getting nervous.
Came last Friday. I usually request it as soon as the window opens so I don't end up doing it the night before.
Of course you do lol. Anything weird on the local side?
District judge race is the one I want to actually read up on. Two names I don't know. Going to look at their rulings this weekend.
Closed the March books. We netted $7,200 between us this month.
Mortgage cleared?
Yep. And Claire's deposit. Owen's robotics fees Friday but we're fine.
Good. Hold the patio quotes til April.
Can you grab me after robotics at 5:30? Also did you take the truck or bike today?
Truck. I'm heading out for the noon loop now, then eating at my desk.
Ok. Mom said not to steal your green container because it has your lunch.
Correct. Lentils, peppers, and the last chicken. No emergency salami run today.
Yellowstone's running clean Saturday morning. Mill Creek access?
Can't this Saturday — I'm at the Carnegie room 10 to 11:30 again. Could do Sunday early if you're around.
The Chromebook crew? Sunday works. Pine Creek trailhead 7?
Done. And hey — if the river's blown out some weekend, I could use a second set of hands at the library. Couple of the regulars asked about email.
Random question. My roommate's family does Lent for real - she's giving up coffee and looks miserable. Did Grandma actually make you guys do the no-meat Friday thing growing up?
Ha. Yeah, fish sticks every Friday in Lent, no negotiating. Grandma Maeve would have skinned us. Ma kept it up too, mostly out of habit.
And now? You and Mom basically never do any of that stuff, right? Like I don't think I've seen you inside a church except for Uncle Patrick's wedding.
Pretty much. The rhythm of it is still in my head, the rules, the guilt, all of it. Just doesn't translate to Sunday mornings anymore. Megan stopped years before I did.
I can do the grocery run if you take the Thursday pickup at the high school. Course bus gets back around 7.
deal. I'll do the dishes too so you can sit down for once.
you're already driving him to two meets this month, you don't have to do dishes also
I want to. it's fine.
absentee ballot for the May municipal showed up. its on the counter under the dental bill
thanks. ill fill mine out tonight after dinner. you doing yours together or separately?
separately. you always take forever reading every candidates statement
fair. school board i want to read all four. mayor im probably going one way and the council seat the other, so i need the statements in front of me
Eileen showed me the picture of your hike up Pine Creek. She wants to know if the trail is still washed out past the bridge.
Dad asked what those sticks cost you. He thinks anything over $40 is robbery.
It cleared up. I'll text her. Tell her I'm not putting Dad stuff or the dental bill stuff on there, just trails and the workshop.
Ha. She figured. Said your page is the most boring one in the family and she means that as a compliment.
Tell him $92 after the coupon, and they are not for looking rugged in photos.
Good. If I needed money or a pep talk I'd call you, not post about it.
Ha. So they actually earn their keep?
On long descents, yes. Cheaper than limping around the stairs for two days.
Cousin Eddie is posting again that the new clinic in town is a scam, all caps, no source. Mom is asking me about it.
Tell her to ignore the thread. He's certain about everything and links nothing.
Yeah. Where do you even get reliable stuff anymore.
Honestly the Livingston Enterprise for local, YPR in the morning, and a couple of forums I trust for the rest. I just don't take big claims from comment sections.
Made it back. Roads were fine after Big Timber, and I only forgot one sock at home this time.
Good. Text when your laundry card needs more. Your mom found the charger under the couch.
Add $20 if you can. Also, about that report, saying it is complicated is not an answer.
I know. I reread the tables. I owe you a better answer than that.
Wind looks tolerable by 8. You still want Mallard's Rest?
Yes. I retied the 4x last night because the loop kept kicking left. Want that fixed before I embarrass myself.
Coffee first. And bring the little box, not your whole garage.
Fair. I need to be home by noon to finish the station platform and fold the basement blankets.
Saw the office light on when I came back for the deposit slips. Have you eaten anything besides coffee?
No. Owen's sandwich bread is gone too.
I'll bring soup. Before the 1:00 call, write the two calls you can finish and the one thing you are punting.
Soup wins. Two calls plus the billing thing. The rest gets punted.
Mom says you sent three different home-care links. You building a spreadsheet empire out there?
Trying not to have six open tabs and no actual next step. I made one page: call list, costs, what Dad will refuse.
Good. I can make calls Monday. Also go to bed before you start color-coding his stubbornness.
That's the plan. No more digging tonight. I'll walk before coffee and send you the clean version.
Yellowstone looks low enough to wade by 8. Wind gets dumb after lunch.
I can do 8. Need one quiet pass before the week starts chewing on me.
Mallard's Rest or Carter's Bridge?
Mallard's. When the peaks come up behind the water there, I remember why we quit talking ourselves back to Colorado.
River looks blown out. Coffee at Neptune's instead?
Can do coffee, but I'm passing on breakfast and any tasting tray. March is already full of receipts.
Plain coffee and bad river talk. Works.
Also I won't be up by Glacier today after all, so no rush on your bear spray.
Katabatic after the river? A couple guys may hang out on the back side if the wind quits.
Inside table works better for me. I am good for one pint, probably the BridgePort if they still have it.
Inside it is. You bringing flies tomorrow or just opinions?
Flies, bad opinions, and an early exit. Megan has dinner started and I promised music duty.

Why do you have a flashlight for a river walk before dinner

Gray? Dad would have a heart attack.

what's next on the stack

Good call. We'll FaceTime in for dinner. Ma will live.

Did you do help desk stuff first or jump into coding right out?
Help desk for almost 3 years. Tickets, imaging laptops, the whole bit. Picked up real dev work on the side until somebody let me do it full time.
Did they tell you about the church steps tonight or did they leave that part out?

Tom caught himself on the rail. No drama, but I watched him take the driveway like it was ice.
Mom asked if you guys ever looked into any of that state program stuff for groceries or the utility help. I told her no but figured I'd ask.

Figured. She worries. Dad's PT copays this month were rough on her end and I think she's projecting.
I'll price the grab bars again tomorrow and call you after work. Hard doing this from out here.
Tell her we're fine. Tires hit us this month but it's just noise. The real watch is property taxes after the reassessment and whether the retirement number still pencils.
dad the athletic waiver form asks parent insurance type - dropdown lists TRICARE, VA, employer plan, marketplace, or other
marketplace. neither of the top two ever applied to me. picking marketplace will route you to the standard liability page

dubuque, iowa for me. fort collins, colorado for mom. write them in exactly like that
field bio trip fee is $340, sorry it is last minute
no worries. put it on our card and forward the receipt, we clear the card at the end of the cycle anyway
thanks dad. you guys still aiming for glacier in september
slowly building the travel pot back up. depends on the rainy day account getting where we want it first
Dad, please do not let Uncle Pat's group chat be your source. The CDC page is two minutes to read.

ok lol. also do you actually use all those languages? java, c#, python all on one team?

Katabatic at 5:45? I want to hear how bad the mud was on your office loop.
Muddy but passable. Third lunch walk this week, somehow.
Look at you. Want me to order the usual two?
Just one for me. I have chili with extra peppers waiting at home anyway.
Dad asked what you're up to lately. told him you were studying again. he said didn't you already finish school in like 2002

less code more meetings huh

uncle ray was off again at sunday dinner. wanted to know if you finally picked a side yet
ha. tell him im still registered the same way i was last time he asked. neither team jersey
he said you lean one way these days though
closer than i used to be, sure. but i still voted for our county sheriff last cycle and the mayor here in 22 went the other direction on my ballot. im not signing up for the whole package either way

can't this sat. Owen has a meet in Belgrade, I'm driving. Sunday?
sunday works. mayfield access?
yeah 7am. I'll bring the thermos.
